dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: Heh. Just singing my daughter's favorite nursery rhymes.

dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: She used to beg me to sing them to her each day the moment I got home... But I was so focused on my work, I—I just ignored her...

dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: And then, I went to Liyue to give a performance... she suddenly fell ill and... she didn't make it. I didn't even get to see her before she died.

dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: All she wanted was for her daddy to sing to her... Such a simple thing. Such a small thing. And I failed to give her even that...

dialogues.speaker: Alfred
dialogues.text: Oh my darling, don't worry, Daddy's here for you... Daddy will always be here for you...
